_note: SHAPE-MATCHED campaign (user 2026-09-26: KDA and MLA must be judged on the SAME input shapes). AGENT = Claude Code (Opus 5.5 via Bedrock). ONE MLA (dense multi-head latent attention) decoder layer of Kimi-K3 on sglang v0.5.20, B200, cookbook production shape (12 heads/rank, cutedsl_mla decode over a paged fp8_e4m3 latent KV, EP8 rank = 112 mxfp4 experts). Points = the union of the decode shapes used so far for either layer: 1x1M (primary), 16x64k with per-request mixed context lengths (`mix`: L, 3L/4, L/2, L/4 — the MLA guard against fixed-length scheduling overfits; KDA's twin is uniform since its state makes it length-independent), 128x8k, 32x8k, 1x8k. Metric = CUDA-graph replay time. Correctness = output + written fp8 KV rows vs a seeded golden from the pristine tree. Driver runs with --bf16-gemm-init and --flashinfer-autotune (production fidelity; parity with the prefill/large-batch cases). GPU mode: slurm (K3_GPU_MODE=slurm; agent container has no GPU, every measurement is one sbatch job on partition main).

render.METRIC: CUDA-graph decode-step latency of one Kimi-K3 MLA decoder layer
render.MODEL_NAME: Kimi-K3 (moonshotai/Kimi-K3): one MLA (dense multi-head latent attention) decoder layer, as it runs on one B200 of the production TP8/EP8 deployment (12 attention heads, cutedsl_mla decode over a paged fp8 latent KV, 112 local mxfp4 experts)
render.WORKLOAD: batched decode, one token per request per step, judged on the SAME five shapes as the KDA layer: B=1 at context 1,048,576 (primary: single-request long-context decode, attention reads 1M fp8 latent-KV tokens), plus B=16 at 65,536 with per-request context lengths cycling L, 3L/4, L/2, L/4 (`mix` tag), B=128 at 8,192, B=32 at 8,192 and B=1 at 8,192 (must not regress)
render.REBUILD_CMD: find /sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} + ; cd /workspace/opt_run && python3 /tmp/kimi_single_layer_decode.py --point 1,8192 --attn-type mla --moe-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --attention-backend cutedsl_mla --attn-heads 12 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --experts 112 --ep 8 --local-topk 2 --hidden-scale 1.0 --cuda-graph --iters 5 --warmup 2 --bf16-gemm-init --flashinfer-autotune && echo LAYER_SMOKE_OK
